name: Arcesilaus
biography: Head of Plato's Academy who redirected it toward Scepticism by treating Platonic dialectic (the inconclusive, aporetic side of Plato's dialogues) as an end in itself; taught by refuting any thesis a pupil proposed and by arguing opposite sides of a question on different days, leaving the Academy sceptical for roughly two centuries.
